verdict.rationale: Eqvista's marketing says it lets companies share diligence materials through a secure built-in data room, and it claims advanced permissions over who can view sensitive equity data, centralized documents and stakeholder access, and controls on shareholder equity-value visibility. All of these are brief marketing lines with no detailed data-room documentation. missing for 10: data-room setup and sharing docs, per-folder or per-user permissions for external counsel and investors, evidence that cap table views live inside the data room alongside documents, access logging or audit trail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
